descriptionFull: The snowy egret ( Egretta thula ) is a small white heron. The genus name comes from the Provençal French for the little egret aigrette , a diminutive of aigron , "heron". The species name thula is the Araucano for the Black-necked Swan, applied to this species in error by Chilean naturalist Juan Ignacio Molina in 1782.
